entries.name: Blog
entries.description: Release notes, postmortems, performance work, and technical writing from the TanStack team.

entries.name: CodeRabbit
entries.description: Code Review. AI code review platform for pull requests, IDEs, and CLI workflows, with automated review comments, one-click fixes, and configurable review rules. Resources: [CodeRabbit quickstart](https://docs.coderabbit.ai/getting-started/quickstart).

entries.name: Cloudflare
entries.description: Deployment/Hosting. Global network and developer platform with Workers, KV, CDN, and security services. Cloudflare also documents deploying TanStack Start apps on Workers. Resources: [Cloudflare TanStack Start guide](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/framework-guides/web-apps/tanstack-start/), [TanStack Start hosting guide](https://tanstack.com/start/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/hosting).

entries.name: Lovable
entries.description: AI/LLM. AI app-building platform for generating, editing, and shipping web apps from prompts, with GitHub sync, visual editing, Lovable Cloud hosting, and new TanStack Start-powered SSR projects. Resources: [Build with a URL in Lovable](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/build-with-url), [Building TanStack Start apps with Lovable](https://lovable.dev/blog/building-apps-using-tanstack-start).

entries.name: Netlify
entries.description: Deployment/Hosting. Where AI apps go from idea to production — build, deploy, and scale it all in one place: Git-to-edge deployment, serverless and edge functions, Deploy Previews, and native support for AI-generated apps (including TanStack Start), so you're not stitching together separate tools for building and shipping. Resources: [TanStack Start hosting guide](https://tanstack.com/start/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/hosting), [TanStack + Netlify partnership](https://tanstack.com/blog/netlify-partnership).

entries.name: Railway
entries.description: Deployment/Hosting. Application deployment platform for shipping from GitHub, the CLI, Docker images, or templates, with managed networking, observability, and configurable scaling. Resources: [TanStack Start hosting guide](https://tanstack.com/start/latest/docs/framework/react/guide/hosting).

entries.name: AG Grid
entries.description: Data Grids. Data grid library with Community and Enterprise editions. Enterprise features include row grouping, pivoting, aggregation, Excel export, integrated charts, and the server-side row model. Resources: [AG Grid with TanStack Table](https://tanstack.com/table/latest/docs/enterprise/ag-grid), [TanStack + AG Grid partnership](https://tanstack.com/blog/ag-grid-partnership).

entries.name: SerpApi
entries.description: API Infrastructure. Search engine results API with structured JSON output, geo-targeting controls, CAPTCHA solving, and support for Google, Maps, Shopping, News, and other engines. Resources: [SerpApi JavaScript integration](https://serpapi.com/integrations/javascript), [SerpApi MCP integration](https://serpapi.com/integrations/mcp).

entries.name: OpenRouter
entries.description: AI/LLM. Unified API for accessing hundreds of AI models from dozens of providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with routing, fallbacks, and privacy controls. Resources: [TanStack AI OpenRouter adapter](https://tanstack.com/ai/latest/docs/adapters/openrouter), [TanStack + OpenRouter partnership](https://tanstack.com/blog/openrouter-partnership).

entries.name: WorkOS
entries.description: Authentication. Enterprise identity platform with SSO, Directory Sync, MFA for AuthKit, RBAC, audit logs, and admin onboarding tools. It is a strong fit for B2B apps that need enterprise auth features. Resources: [WorkOS AuthKit TanStack Start SDK](https://workos.com/docs/sdks/authkit-tanstack-start), [TanStack Start WorkOS example](https://tanstack.com/start/latest/docs/framework/react/examples/start-workos).

entries.name: Clerk
entries.description: Authentication. Authentication and user management platform with prebuilt UI, sessions, organizations, and MFA. Clerk has official SDKs and quickstarts for TanStack React Start and React Router. Resources: [Clerk TanStack Start quickstart](https://clerk.com/docs/tanstack-react-start/getting-started/quickstart), [TanStack Start Clerk example](https://tanstack.com/start/latest/docs/framework/react/examples/start-clerk-basic).

entries.name: Electric
entries.description: Databases. Sync-focused data platform for Postgres-backed apps, including Postgres Sync and the partnered TanStack DB project. It is built for reactive and collaborative applications that need live data sync. Resources: [TanStack DB Electric collection](https://tanstack.com/db/latest/docs/collections/electric-collection).

entries.name: Sentry
entries.description: Error Monitoring. Application monitoring platform for error tracking, tracing, replay, profiling, and logs, with TanStack Router support and an alpha TanStack Start React SDK. Resources: [Sentry for TanStack Start](https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/tanstackstart-react/).

entries.name: Prisma
entries.description: Databases. Open-source TypeScript ORM with Prisma Client, migrations, Prisma Studio, and Prisma Postgres for managed PostgreSQL. Resources: [Prisma with TanStack Start](https://docs.prisma.io/docs/guides/frameworks/tanstack-start).

entries.name: Unkey
entries.description: API Infrastructure. API infrastructure for API key management, rate limiting, usage tracking, audit logs, and access controls. Resources: [Unkey server-side rate limiting](https://www.unkey.com/docs/platform/ratelimiting/introduction), [Unkey API key quickstart](https://www.unkey.com/docs/quickstart/quickstart).
